What's New 📰

You might be wondering about the names next to Game Scripts (Solara, Mobile). Here’s how it works:
(Solara) - This means it only works in the Solara executor or possibly in Wave due to their power.
(Mobile) - This means it works with ALL EXECUTORS (like Wave, Delta, and more).
Note: This applies only to the GAME SECTIONS.
